about: Random tables (dungeon/life/deck.py, Feature Hit List #35): Prospero's Study's d100 tables (server/mechanics/defaults.json) reworded for everyday life, rolled with the same dice (dungeon/life/chance.py). `push` is the top table, after Study's Narrative Push; each of its rows names a table to roll on next (`child`), and that table's rows are what happened. The rows join the Life deck as extra cards, one picker for both: `tables_weight` in life_deck.json is how much room they take next to the cards. `from` names the Study table each one adapts. Study's tables about danger, story structure and dice mechanics (Direct Challenge, Automaton, Handling, Hooks, Arc, Scene and Thread Resolution, Clue, Vector, Boon, Consequence) have no everyday-life version here.

rows.title: An opening
rows.text: Someone asked {first}'s opinion on something they actually know about.
rows.told: Someone asked your opinion on something you actually know about.

rows.title: Things fell into place
rows.text: A few small things {first} had been waiting on all came through at once.
rows.told: A few small things you'd been waiting on all came through at once.

rows.title: A good idea
rows.text: {first} had a good idea in the shower and wrote it down before it vanished.
rows.told: You had a good idea in the shower and wrote it down before it vanished.

rows.title: Easy day
rows.text: {first}'s to-do list went faster than expected.
rows.told: Your to-do list went faster than expected today.

rows.title: Stuck lid
rows.text: A jar lid refused to open and {first} had to fight it for five minutes.
rows.told: A jar lid refused to open and you fought it for five minutes.

rows.title: Misheard
rows.text: Someone misheard {first} and they had to explain the same thing three times.
rows.told: Someone misheard you and you had to explain the same thing three times.

rows.title: Too loud
rows.text: A loud group nearby made it hard for {first} to think.
rows.told: A loud group nearby made it hard for you to think.

rows.title: Long queue

rows.told: Every line you stood in today was the slow one.

rows.title: App update
rows.text: An app {first} uses every day updated and moved all the buttons.
rows.told: An app you use every day updated and moved all the buttons.

rows.title: Wet sock

rows.told: You stepped in a puddle and had a wet sock for hours.

rows.title: Closed

rows.told: The place you meant to go was unexpectedly closed.

rows.told: You ended up with two things due at the same time.

rows.title: Sold out

rows.told: The thing you went out to buy was sold out everywhere.

rows.title: Small cost

rows.told: Fixing a small problem at home cost you more than it should have.

rows.title: Moved

rows.told: Something you had planned got moved to another day.

rows.told: You got called away halfway through doing something else.

rows.title: Plans swapped

rows.told: {friend} suggested a different plan and you went along with it.

rows.told: A stranger asked you for directions and you walked them halfway there.

rows.told: A chatty older neighbor told you the whole history of your street.

rows.told: Someone in line recommended a book to you, very insistently.

rows.told: A lost tourist asked you to take their photo, five times.

rows.told: Something you needed was on sale today.

rows.told: You found a quiet corner nearby that's perfect for reading.

rows.told: It went from sunny to hail to sunny again in ten minutes where you were.

rows.title: Old place changed
